title: Research Report Specification
description: Structured output for iterative research synthesis with deep (10+ rounds) or scoped depth.

objective.description: The core hypothesis, question, or problem being researched.

feature_ticket_ref.description: Optional path or ID linking to feature-ticket.json when research supports requirements work.

depth_mode.description: deep = default 10+ rounds; scoped = user- or BA-narrowed depth with documented waiver.

total_rounds.description: Distinct research loops executed. Minimum 10 when depth_mode is deep; minimum 3 when scoped.

scope_waiver_note.description: Required when depth_mode is scoped: who narrowed scope and why fewer rounds are sufficient.

inferences.description: Labeled inferences that are not fully verified.

critical_gaps.description: Missing, ambiguous, or unverifiable information after research.

confidence_score.description: Overall confidence based on data triangulation.

credibility.description: Source tier per researcher source hierarchy: Primary (gov/official/peer-reviewed), Secondary (reputable news/expert), Tertiary (Wikipedia/reference), AI-generated (never cite — query use only).

source_type.description: Optional: e.g. government-record, peer-reviewed-journal, news-article, industry-report, official-docs.

recommended_next_roles.description: Downstream owners; Researcher recommends but does not decide for them.

role.description: Target role slug, e.g. technical-architect, business-analyst, content-writer.

residual_risks.description: Risks and skipped checks when certainty is limited.

information_gain.description: Required when handing off to Content Writer or SEO Analyst. Documents unique research value vs top SERP results.

unique_insights.description: Findings not present in top-5 SERP results for the target keyword — raw material for information gain.

firsthand_evidence_available.description: Whether primary interviews, original data, or firsthand accounts are accessible and noted for the Writer.

firsthand_evidence_notes.description: Describe the firsthand evidence if firsthand_evidence_available is true.

ai_coverage_gap.description: Topics where AI Overviews / AI answers are incorrect, incomplete, or missing — high-value citation opportunities.

ymyl_elevation_required.description: True when topic touches health, legal, financial, or safety domains and requires human expert review before publication.

ymyl_notes.description: Describe which YMYL domain applies and what expert review is recommended.

cove_log.description: Chain-of-Verification audit trail. Mandatory when ymyl_adjacent is true or when handing off critical claims.

ymyl_adjacent.description: True when topic touches health, legal, financial, or safety domains — CoVe is mandatory.

claims_verified.description: Claims confirmed against original source document with URL.

reason.description: Why unverified: source not retrieved, 404, mismatch, etc.

claims_unverified.description: Claims that could not be confirmed — labeled [UNVERIFIED] in synthesis.

ai_source_discipline.description: Machine-readable AI source audit trail. Documents AI tools used for query-only and any citation mismatches found.

ai_tools_used_for_queries.description: AI tools used only to generate search queries and identify sub-topics (not cited as sources). E.g. Perplexity, ChatGPT, Google AI Overview.

ai_citation_mismatches.description: AI-CITATION MISMATCH entries: URLs or facts provided by AI tools that could not be confirmed in original documents.

grounding_completeness_pct.description: Percentage of material claims that have a verifiable source URL. Target: 100% for primary claims.

examples.objective: Understand COD order courier routing patterns in SE Asian logistics platforms to inform assignment engine design.

key_findings: Store-specific courier pools reduce COD delivery failure rate by 23% vs centralized assignment (Shopee logistics whitepaper 2024)
Fallback to 3PL on no store courier is standard practice; all platforms log and alert on fallback
inferences: [INFERENCE] Centralized queues may increase latency due to cross-zone assignment — not confirmed in reviewed documents
critical_gaps: Specific performance benchmarks for COD routing latency not found across all platforms reviewed

raw_data_references.context_summary: Whitepaper on store-specific courier pool performance metrics
Documents 3PL fallback chain and alerting pattern

recommended_next_roles.rationale: Research findings provide trade-off basis for assignment engine architecture decision
Market patterns need translation into acceptance criteria for the routing feature ticket

residual_risks: Shopee whitepaper not publicly accessible — summary relies on secondary reporting; direct confirmation pending

unique_insights: 23% failure rate reduction with store-specific pools — not found in top-5 SERP for 'COD courier routing SE Asia'
ai_coverage_gap: AI Overviews incorrectly state 'all platforms use centralized routing' — contradicted by both Shopee and Grab documentation

claims_submitted: Store-specific courier pools reduce COD delivery failure rate by 23%
Fallback to 3PL on no store courier is standard practice

claims_verified.claim: Fallback to 3PL on no store courier is standard practice

claims_unverified.claim: Store-specific courier pools reduce COD delivery failure rate by 23%
claims_unverified.reason: Shopee blog post not publicly retrievable; stat sourced from secondary reporting — labeled [UNVERIFIED] in synthesis

ai_citation_mismatches.claimed_fact: Shopee uses centralized routing for all COD orders
ai_citation_mismatches.mismatch_reason: URL returns 404; contradicts 2024 whitepaper finding — flagged [AI-CITATION MISMATCH]
